entities.name: National Defense University of Ukraine

entities.summary: The National Defence University of Ukraine is a public university of higher military education in Ukraine, located in its capital city of Kyiv. Subordinated to the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine, the university trains officers specializing in national defence.
